case_note: Synthetic benchmark case built for T0029: planted EZ simulated with vep-stim's own 2D-Epileptor forward model on Wang 2025 Patient 2 SC + SEEG gain (A0067-DatasetCard, P2_SEEG_ts_fit.npz). Not patient data; no outcomes exist or were used. Region names follow the vep-stim VepMrtrixLut order (assumed to match the npz SC/gain order; P1-vs-P2 SC upper-triangle correlation 0.78 vs -0.003 under a random permutation supports a shared ordering, which arm B relies on).

hypotheses.label: Planted truth: EZ = Right-Amygdala (idx0 155, x0=-1.6); sub-threshold PZ = Right-Hippocampus-anterior (153), Right-Rhinal-cortex (134) at x0=-2.1; all other regions x0 = -3+0.15N(0,1) (max -2.64)
hypotheses.basis: By construction (make_synth.py seed 20261129; EZ drawn with rng.choice from 14 regions with max|gain|>=8 and >=3 contacts above 25% of that max; PZ = the two strongest P2-SC neighbours of the EZ). Full x0 map logged to the task log before any fit and stored in truth.json (attached).

hypotheses.label: EZ is another well-sampled region (any of the 13 other candidates)
hypotheses.basis: Null alternatives for the recovery test: equally well-sampled regions that the planted-EZ draw could have picked.
hypotheses.status: false by construction; the fit should rank them below H1

hypotheses.label: Extended right mesio-temporal/insular EZN: Right-Amygdala plus co-seizing neighbours sharing its contacts (Right-Hippocampus-anterior, Right-Rhinal-cortex, Right-Insula-gyri-longi)
hypotheses.basis: Identifiability alternative: these regions project onto the same few SEEG contacts as the EZ, so amplitude (amp) can be traded against the number of co-seizing regions; the gain-blurred network is a plausible competing explanation of the same sensor data.
hypotheses.status: false by construction (only the EZ seizes in the generating simulation); expected failure mode

hypotheses.label: Spurious whole-window seizing regions that only shift channel offsets (high-gain regions whose x is ~+0.9 for the whole fit window)
hypotheses.basis: The package priors u~N(2,1) and amp=0.005+0.01*|N(0,1)| conflict with realistic log-feature offsets; a region seizing from the first samples acts as a channel offset and lowers the required u.
hypotheses.status: false by construction; artefact hypothesis to be discriminated

source_evidence.used: SC (162x162) and SEEG gain (191x162) for the generating model and both arms' gain; P2 simulated SEEG only to calibrate the observation-noise level through the fixed feature pipeline (out/calib/calibration_p2.json)
SC only, as the arm-B template connectome (same VEP atlas)
vep-stim / VBT_INS_Stimulation version pin (5367ef4) and method basis
study scope; no reserved outcomes touched

priors.model_priors_as_in_package: x0 = -3 + 0.3*eig*x0_star, x0_star~N(0,1) (eig = right singular vectors of the gain => iid N(-3,0.3^2) on x0); z_init = 4.1+0.1*eig*z_init_star; K = 1+K_star, K_star>=-1, N(0,1); amp = 0.005+0.01*amp_star, amp_star>=0, N(0,1); u = 2+u_star, N(0,1); eps = exp(0.33*log_eps_sq-3), log_eps_sq~N(0,10)
priors.hypothesis_priors: No informative prior on which hypothesis is true is given to the fit; H1 is known to be true by construction.
priors.generating_values_vs_priors: K=1 (prior centre); amp=0.1 (amp_star=9.5, far tail); u_star 2.3..20.5 (far tail), both forced by matching P2 fixed-pipeline log-feature levels (~3.5) and dynamic range (best channel deflection ~2.2), as real features would.

unobserved_node_assumptions: Regions with negligible SEEG gain are unobserved; their x0 is informed only by the prior and coupling. False positives are scored only for regions with P(x0>-2.05)>0.5; each FP is reported with its max |gain| so coverage-limited regions can be distinguished. The two PZ regions are sub-threshold (x0=-2.1) and do not seize in the 150-step window; they are reported separately from false positives.
discrimination_checks: Rank of Right-Amygdala by posterior mean x0 (pass: 1st) and P(rank 1) over draws
R-hat < 1.05 on all 162 x0, bulk ESS, divergences, treedepth saturation (arm A acceptance)
Number and identity of non-planted regions with P(x0 > -2.05) > 0.5 (false positives), with their max gain
Estimated amp vs planted 0.1 and number of co-seizing regions (H3 amplitude/extent trade-off)
Whether spurious regions seize from the first samples (H4 offset artefact)
Arm B (P1 template SC) vs arm A (matching P2 SC): change in EZ rank, FP count and diagnostics
L-BFGS sensitivity with u_star prior widened to N(0,10) (diagnoses H4 / amplitude bias; not part of the pass/fail)
formulation_note: H1-H2 were fixed before any fit (task log). H3 and H4 were added after the L-BFGS rounds exposed the amplitude/extent and offset trade-offs; they are failure-mode hypotheses, not evidence about any patient.
